title: IT Working Student
description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

Our Global IT Team is responsible for the productivity and success of all our organizational functions and teams. We empower others to be productive, collaborate and do the best work they can, while keeping a close eye on compliance and the safety of our organization. We are looking for an IT Working Student based in our Berlin office who offers hands-on and remote support to all employees.

You will handle incoming tech support issues, analyze the tasks at hand, and resolve them in collaboration with your team. To you, a perfect solution is not complete until all questions are answered, and every party involved is happy with the end result.

The ideal candidate studies a computer science-related field, enjoys working with people, and has a strong technical interest. Learning is your daily routine and you are not scared of new challenges. You should have worked with Mac OSX and Windows before; debugging the issues at hand around you is just normal for you - you are a self-starter who enjoys taking on responsibility. Bonus points if you have programming experience or have worked on a technical service desk before.

title: Praktikum Commercial Operations & Account Management
description:
Praktikum Commercial Operations & Account Management
 UNSERE MISSION
Wir wollen die erste Anlaufstelle für den Autowechsel werden. Mit einer Kombination aus Technologie, Medien und tiefem Verständnis für den Automobilsektor haben wir schon jetzt die Art wie Menschen Autos (ver)kaufen, vermarkten und leasen, auf den Kopf gestellt.
Was als einfache Neuwagen-Vergleichsplattform begann, ist heute einer der größten Online-Marktplätze für den Autowechsel in Europa . Im letzten Jahr allein sind wir dabei mit Fahrzeugen, die im Wert von über £3bn über unser Portal gekauft, geleast oder versteigert wurden, um über 50% gewachsen.
2024 haben wir mit der Übernahme von Autovia – der Plattform hinter AutoExpress und dem Evo Magazin – anschließend unsere Reichweite über Nacht verdoppelt. Zusammen zählen wir nun mit fast 10 Mio. Abonnenten und 1,1 Mrd. jährlichen Aufrufen zu den größten YouTube-Kanälen der Welt. Daneben verkaufen wir 1,2 Mio. Kopien unseres Print-Magazins und erreichen jährlich über 350 Mio. Menschen mit unserem Web-Content.
Und wir sind noch lange nicht fertig.
 GET YOUR CAR @ CARWOW
Mit unserer Business Unit "Get Your Car" machen wir den Prozess, das nächste Fahrzeug zu finden, so einfach, smart und transparent wie nie zuvor.
Nach unserer erfolgreichen Series-E-Finanzierungsrunde mit über 52 Mio. US-Dollar starten wir jetzt in eine neue Wachstumsphase.
Unser Commercial-Team spielt dabei eine Schlüsselrolle: Wir unterstützen unsere Partnerhändler dabei, ihre Performance auf unserer Plattform zu maximieren und schaffen so echte Mehrwerte auf beiden Seiten - für Käufer:innen und Händler.
Wenn du Lust hast, direkt mit Autohäusern zusammenzuarbeiten und so die Zukunft des Autohandels aktiv mitgestalten möchtest, dann bist du hier genau richtig.
Du wirst Teil eines schlanken, dynamischen Teams, das eng mit unseren Produkt-, Marketing- und Analytics-Teams zusammenarbeiten.

title: Direct Contractor Tunisia & Morocco
description:
Why loveholidays?
 At loveholidays - we trailblaze together . We're holiday devotees on a mission to become the world's most-loved holiday brand. We love your holiday as much as you do, and we're transforming the everyday through the power of loveholidays - bringing that holiday joy to millions. Our team is the driving force behind our challenger brand journey, operating with playful, devoted and joyful energy as we compete against bigger competitors through creativity, cultural connection and outsized ambition.
 We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Supply team, you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams.
 About the team
 The Land Supply team is a central driver of loveholidays’ success. We are responsible for sourcing all of the bookable land products in our marketplace. Our mission is to secure the broadest range of inventory at the most competitive rates, availability & customer experience quality. We bridge the gap between data-driven yield management and long-term relationship building. As we grow towards our vision of becoming the global leader in package holidays, we are scaling directly contracted inventory and this team is leading that evolution.
   The impact you’ll have
 In this role, you will primarily lead our direct contracting activity across Tunisia & Morocco, with the opportunity to expand into other geographies over time. You will play a critical role not just in direct contracting with hoteliers on behalf of loveholidays, but will contribute strongly to the design of a best-in-class sourcing strategy for our future growth.

title: Head of Contracting
description:
Why loveholidays?
At loveholidays - we trailblaze together . We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.
 We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams , you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams.
 About the team:
 The Land Supply team is a central driver of loveholidays’ success. We are responsible for sourcing all of the bookable land products in our marketplace. Our mission is to secure the broadest range of inventory at the most competitive rates, availability & customer experience quality. We bridge the gap between data-driven yield management and long-term relationship building. As we grow towards our vision of becoming the global leader in package holidays, we are scaling directly contracted inventory and this team is leading that evolution.
 The impact you’ll have:
 In this role, you will primarily lead our direct contracting activity across key assigned destinations, with the opportunity to expand into other geographies over time. You will play a critical role not just in direct contracting with hoteliers on behalf of loveholidays, but will contribute strongly to the design of a best-in-class sourcing strategy for our future growth.
 Ideally, you will be based within your designated region with strong local market connections. You will be our primary regional presence, leveraging your industry relationships to ensure loveholidays is a preferred partner for major hotel chains and DMCs.…
